_meta.source: SRTR PSR National Center-Level Summary Data (January 2025 release)
_meta.method: 12-month waitlist outcomes from Table B7 — died-on-waitlist as annual mortality proxy, removals (worsened + other + refused) as delisting proxy
_meta.notes: Center-level rates from SRTR Table B7. Urgency and clinical multipliers retained from literature estimates. (#293: the legacy 22-city block was retired 2026-08-25 — per-center data lives in the *-centers.json files.)

age_mortality_multipliers._notes: Age-group waitlist mortality multipliers. Source: SRTR 2023 Annual Data Report Table 5.3 (kidney, extrapolated to other organs). Reference age group: 50-64.
age_mortality_multipliers._pediatric_notes: '0-17' derived by scripts/derive-pediatric-mortality.py from SRTR pediatric waitlist death rates vs adult Table B7, shrunk toward the pooled ratio at 200 person-years. Anchored to the all-listed-adult hazard (multiplier 1.0 = average listed adult).

age_organ_overrides._notes: Organ-specific adjustments to the base age multipliers. Heart mortality is extremely age-sensitive; kidney is less so. Source: SRTR organ-specific waitlist survival tables.
